# Velox Peptides

> UK supplier of HPLC-verified research peptides (≥99% purity, third-party batch-tested) for in vitro laboratory research only. Operated by CRP Labs Ltd, Holywood, Northern Ireland (UK company no. NI738125). Same-day UK dispatch. No products are licensed medicines; nothing is supplied for human or veterinary use.

Key facts: every batch is HPLC-verified with certificates of analysis available in the public CoA library. Flagship compound: Retatrutide (LY3437943), a GLP-1/GIP/glucagon triple agonist. The site also hosts free research tools, including Velox Design Lab — an AI tool that generates novel research-peptide sequences scored for novelty and synthesisability.

For a single-fetch digest of the definitive answer to every research guide and compound, see [llms-full.txt](https://veloxpeps.com/llms-full.txt).

## Compounds (research reagents)

- [Retatrutide](https://veloxpeps.com/compounds/retatrutide/): GLP-1/GIP/glucagon triple agonist (LY3437943), 10mg, 15mg, 20mg lyophilised vials and 10mg 10-pack, ≥99% HPLC purity
- [BPC-157](https://veloxpeps.com/compounds/bpc-157/): pentadecapeptide studied in tissue-repair research models
- [TB-500](https://veloxpeps.com/compounds/tb-500/): thymosin beta-4 fragment studied in recovery research
- [CJC-1295](https://veloxpeps.com/compounds/cjc-1295/): GHRH analogue research reagent
- [Ipamorelin](https://veloxpeps.com/compounds/ipamorelin/): selective ghrelin-receptor agonist research reagent
- [GHK-Cu](https://veloxpeps.com/compounds/ghk-cu/): copper tripeptide studied in skin and tissue research
- [Semax](https://veloxpeps.com/compounds/semax/) and [Selank](https://veloxpeps.com/compounds/selank/): cognitive-research peptides
- [All compounds](https://veloxpeps.com/compounds/): full catalogue by research category

## Research guides (literature summaries)

- [Retatrutide research overview](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide/): mechanism, receptor pharmacology, and published TRIUMPH-1 Phase 3 (2026) trial data
- [Retatrutide side effects &amp; tolerability](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-side-effects/): summary of adverse-event and tolerability data reported across the retatrutide Phase 2/3 trial programme
- [Retatrutide FDA &amp; MHRA Approval Timeline](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-fda-approval-timeline/): regulatory pathway reference — Phase 3 milestones (TRIUMPH-4, TRIUMPH-1, TRANSCEND-T2D-1), NDA filing expected Q4 2026, FDA approval estimated late 2027, MHRA UK ~2028; pending trials (TRIUMPH-2, TRIUMPH-3 CVD) and research-use context (published 23 June 2026)
- [Retatrutide FDA Expanded Access 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-expanded-access-2026/): June 2026 compassionate-use grant explained — what FDA expanded access (21 CFR 312.310) is, why it was granted for one patient outside Phase 3, and what it signals for the NDA/approval timeline (2027–2028 earliest)
- [Retatrutide Dysesthesia: TRIUMPH-4 Safety Signal (ADA 2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-dysesthesia/): TRIUMPH-4 Phase 3 data (ADA, 6 June 2026) identified dysesthesia in 20.9% of retatrutide 12 mg participants vs 0.7% placebo — a class-unique signal not seen with tirzepatide or semaglutide; glucagon receptor mechanism hypothesis and NDA implications (28 June 2026)
- [Tirzepatide guide](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/tirzepatide/): dual-agonist incretin research summary
- [Ipamorelin guide](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/ipamorelin/): ghrelin-receptor research summary
- [Retatrutide in Type 2 Diabetes: TRANSCEND-T2D-1](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-type-2-diabetes/): Phase 3 trial data (The Lancet, June 2026) — A1C reduction and weight loss in early-onset T2D
- [Peptide Research Landscape 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-research-landscape-2026/): overview of the year's major peptide trials across every compound class; hub linking to every compound summary and comparison (last updated June 2026)
- [Retatrutide & Knee Osteoarthritis: TRIUMPH-4 Phase 3 Data](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-osteoarthritis/): TRIUMPH-4 Phase 3 (Eli Lilly, Dec 2025, n=445) — retatrutide 12 mg reported 75.8% WOMAC pain reduction and 28.7% weight loss at 68 weeks in adults with obesity and knee OA; first Phase 3 to hit both musculoskeletal and body-weight endpoints
- [SURMOUNT-5: Tirzepatide vs Semaglutide](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/surmount-5-tirzepatide-vs-semaglutide/): summary of the first major head-to-head trial of tirzepatide versus semaglutide for weight reduction
- [Survodutide (BI 456906)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/survodutide/): research summary of the GLP-1/glucagon dual receptor agonist studied in obesity and MASH
- [TRIUMPH-1 Phase 3: Retatrutide 80-Week Obesity Data (2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-triumph-1-obesity/): TRIUMPH-1 (n=2,339, 80 wks) — retatrutide 12mg reported 28.3% body-weight reduction vs 2.2% placebo; secondary endpoints: −41.0% TG, −24.2% non-HDL, −12.3 mmHg SBP, −9.5 in waist; 104-wk extension (BMI≥35): −30.3%; topline 21 May 2026, ADA 2026; NDA targeted Q4 2026
- [Retatrutide &amp; Obstructive Sleep Apnea: TRIUMPH-1 Phase 3 Subgroup Data (ADA 2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-sleep-apnea/): pre-specified subgroup from TRIUMPH-1 (ADA, 6 June 2026) — retatrutide 12mg reduced AHI by 60.6% (36.1 events/h) in moderate-to-severe OSA at 80 weeks; includes comparison with tirzepatide SURMOUNT-OSA data
- [GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Epigenetic Aging: 2026 Evidence](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/glp-1-epigenetic-aging-2026/): first RCT evidence (Nature Communications, May 2026; n=84) that semaglutide shifts validated epigenetic aging clocks — PhenoAge −4.9 yrs, DunedinPACE −9% pace — in a 32-week trial; research implications for GLP-1 class receptor pharmacology including retatrutide
- [GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Cardiovascular Risk in Obesity with Autoimmune Disease (JAHA 2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/glp-1-autoimmune-cardiovascular-2026/): target trial emulation (JAHA, June 2026; n=26,000+) — GLP-1 RA use linked to 44% lower all-cause mortality, 31% lower PE risk, 17% lower VTE risk and 13% lower stroke/TIA risk in adults with obesity and autoimmune disease; mechanistic discussion of GLP-1R signalling in inflammatory and thromboembolic pathways
- [Tirzepatide & Brown Adipose Tissue: TABFAT Trial (ENDO 2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/tirzepatide-brown-adipose-tissue-endo-2026/): TABFAT randomised placebo-controlled trial (NCT06893211, n=34), presented ENDO 2026 (Endocrine Society, 15 June 2026) — tirzepatide raised PET/CT-detected brown adipose tissue activity from 41.2% to 64.7% of participants over 24 weeks, independent of weight loss; compares GIPR-mediated thermogenesis with retatrutide's glucagon-receptor mechanism
- [Retatrutide Cardiometabolic Markers: TRIUMPH-1 Phase 3 Data (ADA 2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-cardiometabolic-trial-data/): full cardiometabolic secondary-endpoint data from TRIUMPH-1 and TRANSCEND-T2D-1 as presented at the ADA 86th Scientific Sessions (6 June 2026) — triglycerides −41%, non-HDL cholesterol −24.2%, systolic BP −12.3 mmHg, waist circumference −24.1 cm at 80 weeks on retatrutide 12 mg; BMI normalisation data included
- [FDA Peptide Reclassification 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/fda-peptide-reclassification-2026/): 12 peptides including BPC-157, TB-500, MOTS-c, Semax, DSIP, GHK-Cu and KPV removed from FDA 503A Category 2 (April 2026); PCAC review July 2026
- [Elecoglipron SOLSTICE &amp; VISTA: AstraZeneca's Oral GLP-1 RA Advances to Phase 3 (ADA 2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/elecoglipron-solstice-ada-2026/): Phase 2b SOLSTICE (T2D, n=404, 26 wks) and Phase 2 VISTA (obesity) trials published The Lancet June 2026 — elecoglipron 75mg achieved −1.9% HbA1c and up to 10.5% weight loss; Phase 3 planned
- [GLP-1 & Biological Aging: Semaglutide Epigenetic Study 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/semaglutide-epigenetic-aging-2026/): Nature Communications RCT (Corley et al., May 2026; PMID 40791720) — first placebo-controlled evidence that a GLP-1 receptor agonist (semaglutide) slows biological aging; DunedinPACE −9%, PhenoAge −4.9 years, PCGrimAge −3.1 years in 32-week trial (n=84 HIV-associated lipohypertrophy)
- [Oral Semaglutide UK: MHRA Approval June 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/oral-semaglutide-mhra-uk-2026/): MHRA approved oral semaglutide 25 mg (Wegovy tablet, Novo Nordisk) for UK weight management on 11 Jun 2026 — first oral GLP-1 in Europe; OASIS 4 Phase 3 reported 13.6% weight loss at 64 weeks; covers SNAC absorption mechanism, comparison with injectable Wegovy and retatrutide pipeline
- [PCAC July 2026: BPC-157, TB-500 & Semax FDA Hearing](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/pcac-july-2026-peptide-hearing/): FDA Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee meets 23–24 Jul 2026 to vote on 503A compounding eligibility for BPC-157, TB-500, KPV, MOTS-c, DSIP, Semax and Epitalon; day-by-day agenda, process explainer, and UK research-use context (June 2026)
- [FDA PCAC July 2026: BPC-157, TB-500 &amp; 5 More Peptides](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/pcac-july-2026-bpc-157-tb-500/): FDA Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee meets 23–24 July 2026 to vote on 503A Category 1 status for BPC-157, KPV, TB-500, MOTS-c (Day 1) and DSIP, Semax, Epitalon (Day 2); public comment deadline 9 July 2026 (docket FDA-2025-N-6895)
- [Lilly's Quintuple Agonist: 5-Receptor Metabolic Agonist (ADA 2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/lilly-quintuple-agonist-ada-2026/): ADA 2026 Poster 2839-LB (Indiana Biosciences / Lilly-funded, 7 June 2026) — VRX-0075, a long-acting quintuple agonist targeting GLP-1/GIP/glucagon/amylin/calcitonin receptors, induced greater weight loss than retatrutide in obese rats at equal molar dose; half-life ~50% longer than semaglutide; in vitro potency matches retatrutide at triple-G receptors and cagrilintide at amylin/calcitonin receptors; preclinical only, no human trials announced
- [FDA Briefing Documents Flag Evidence Gaps for BPC-157, TB-500 & Five More Peptides](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/pcac-july-2026-fda-evidence-review/): FDA briefing documents posted 29 June 2026 ahead of the 23–24 July PCAC hearing (docket FDA-2025-N-6895) — agency scientists found no human-administration studies for TB-500 or KPV, and insufficient evidence to evaluate BPC-157 for tendinitis or Crohn's/celiac disease (NPR, NBC News); separately, STAT News (29 June 2026) reported several newly appointed PCAC panellists have commercial ties to the peptide industry
- [Sandoz Files for Generic Tirzepatide: FDA Accepts First ANDA Applications](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/tirzepatide-generic-anda-2026/): FDA accepted two Sandoz ANDAs (29 June 2026) for an in-house generic tirzepatide autoinjector referencing Mounjaro and Zepbound — the first generic filing in the class; explains why NCE exclusivity expiring May 2027 does not mean a 2027 launch, since device/formulation patents are tracked into the mid-2030s, and how the ANDA pathway differs from 503B compounding and research-reagent supply
- [Retatrutide Black-Market Sales Trigger a Poison Center Surge](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-black-market-poison-centers-2026/): America's Poison Centers data (via Medscape, 26 June 2026) showed retatrutide exposure reports averaging 95/month in early 2026, a 265% rise vs late 2025; CBS News investigation (2 July 2026) found unapproved vials sold via 120+ websites, 50+ clinics and a Brooklyn bodega; explains why no compounding pathway exists (unlike the PCAC-reviewed peptides) since retatrutide remains unapproved anywhere and is legally available only in Lilly's clinical trials
- [MHRA, ASA and GPhC Crack Down on 'Pipeline' Weight-Loss Drug Advertising](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/glp-1-advertising-crackdown-uk-2026/): joint MHRA/ASA/GPhC statement (18 June 2026) warns UK businesses against advertising unlicensed "pipeline" weight-management drugs, waiting lists and newly licensed oral GLP-1s; cites ASA Enforcement Report (~900 non-compliant ads of 95,000+ reviewed, Feb 2025-Jan 2026) and GPhC review (16 April 2026, 1,307 concerns logged); explains why Velox markets retatrutide and all compounds as in vitro research reagents only, with no weight-loss framing or waiting lists
- [Retatrutide vs Berobenatide vs Enicepatide: ADA 2026 Obesity-Pipeline Data](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-berobenatide-enicepatide/): Pfizer's berobenatide (Phase 2b VESPER-1/3, press release 5 June 2026) reported up to 15.9% weight loss with a monthly-dosing profile; Roche's enicepatide (Phase 2 CT388-103, press release 1 June 2026) reported up to 22.7% at 48 weeks; both trail retatrutide's Phase 3 TRIUMPH-1 result of 28.3% at 80 weeks (30.3% at 104-week extension); explains why neither competitor compound is available as a research reagent
- [Retatrutide vs Survodutide: Comparing MASLD Liver-Fat Trial Data](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-survodutide-liver-fat-2026/): Boehringer/Zealand's survodutide Phase 3 SYNCHRONIZE-MASLD trial (Nature Medicine, 8 June 2026, n=216) reported 84.2% of participants reached a 30%+ liver-fat reduction vs 24.3% placebo; compares this with retatrutide's own Phase 2a MASLD trial (Sanyal et al., Nature Medicine, 2024) which reported 86.0% mean liver-fat reduction and 93% steatosis resolution at 12mg; explains why trial phase matters more than the headline number
- [MOTS-c Phase 2a Human Trial (2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/mots-c-phase-2a-trial-2026/): Hudson Biotech registered NCT07505745, a Phase 2a randomised placebo-controlled trial testing investigational MOTS-c for insulin sensitivity in prediabetes and overweight/obesity — the first trial to dose MOTS-c directly in humans; explains the preclinical AMPK/insulin-sensitivity rationale, why CohBar's earlier MOTS-c-analogue programme CB4211 ended with its 2023 merger into TuHURA Biosciences, and how this differs from the separate FDA PCAC compounding review of MOTS-c on 23–24 July 2026
- [Health Canada Approves Sevmia: First Generic Semaglutide for Weight Management](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/generic-semaglutide-canada-sevmia-2026/): Health Canada approved Apotex's Sevmia (29 June 2026), a generic semaglutide referencing Novo Nordisk's Wegovy — the third generic semaglutide approved in Canada but the first for the weight-management/cardiovascular-risk indication; six further generic submissions remain under review and no Sevmia price or launch date is published yet; compares the approval to the slower US Sandoz generic-tirzepatide ANDA filing accepted the same day
- [FDA Sets February 2027 PCAC Date for GHK-Cu and Melanotan-II](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/ghk-cu-melanotan-pcac-february-2027/): trade-press and compounding-law reporting confirms a second FDA Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee session, before end of February 2027, covering GHK-Cu (injectable), Melanotan II, LL-37, DiHexa and PEG-MGF — the five peptides removed from 503A Category 2 on 15 April 2026 but held back from the 23–24 July 2026 hearing; explains the GHK-Cu injectable/topical route split and what a PCAC date does and doesn't mean for compounding status
- [US Peptide Compounding Limits Have Fuelled a Grey Market (NPR)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-compounding-grey-market-2026/): NPR (8 July 2026) reports that US 503A compounding restrictions have pushed demand for BPC-157, TB-500 and MOTS-c to an unvetted overseas grey market, ahead of the FDA's 23-24 July 2026 PCAC vote; FDA scientists have recommended against listing any of the seven peptides under review
- [FDA Curbs Bulk Tirzepatide Compounding: 503B Bulks List Explained](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/fda-503b-bulks-list-tirzepatide-semaglutide-2026/): FDA (30 April 2026) proposed excluding semaglutide, tirzepatide and liraglutide from the 503B Bulks List, finding no clinical need for outsourcing-facility bulk compounding; comment period extended (26 June 2026) to 30 July 2026; explains why this Section 503B determination is distinct from the separate Section 503A PCAC review of BPC-157, TB-500 and five other research peptides
- [Retatrutide & Cognition: A New Preclinical Diabetic-Rat Study](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-cognitive-effects-preclinical-study/): unreviewed bioRxiv/SSRN preprint (Keskin et al., Kutahya Health Sciences University, posted Jan 2026, revised Apr 2026) reports retatrutide partly preserved Morris Water Maze and Passive Avoidance performance and significantly reduced hippocampal TNF-alpha in streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats (0.015 mg/kg SC, 21 days); preclinical rodent data only, not yet peer-reviewed, unrelated to the human TRIUMPH Phase 3 programme
- [Retatrutide Arrhythmia Signal: TRANSCEND-T2D-1 Cardiac Safety Data](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-arrhythmia-cardiovascular-signal-2026/): STAT News (6 June 2026) reporting on TRANSCEND-T2D-1 (The Lancet, PMID 42250575, n=537) found arrhythmia in 7 of 403 retatrutide participants vs 0 of 134 on placebo, plus 3 major cardiovascular events vs 0; discusses the glucagon-receptor heart-rate mechanism, class comparison with semaglutide's SELECT and tirzepatide's SURPASS-CVOT, and the pending TRIUMPH-Outcomes cardiovascular trial (NCT05882045)
- [Retatrutide TRIUMPH-2 & TRIUMPH-3: What's Left in the Phase 3 Programme](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-triumph-2-3-pending-trials-2026/): tracks retatrutide's remaining ClinicalTrials.gov registrations — TRIUMPH-2 (NCT05929079, obesity + type 2 diabetes, ~1,400 patients, active-not-recruiting Apr 2026) and TRIUMPH-3 (NCT05882045, obesity + cardiovascular disease, 80-week weight endpoint), both expected later 2026 — and explains why neither is statistically powered for cardiovascular safety, a question reserved for the separate ~10,000-patient event-driven outcomes trial (NCT06383390) not expected to read out before 2027-2029
- [Retatrutide TRIUMPH-9: A New Phase 3 Trial Testing Dose-Escalation Design](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-triumph-9-dose-escalation-2026/): newly identified ClinicalTrials.gov registration NCT07357415, informally tracked as TRIUMPH-9 — tests different dose-escalation regimens for retatrutide in ~600 adults with obesity/overweight who do not have type 2 diabetes, rather than testing a new maintenance dose; reported enrolling at Lilly sites by April 2026; compares against the fixed 2/4/6/9/12mg titration schedule used in TRIUMPH-1 and TRIUMPH-4 (Giblin et al., Diabetes Obesity and Metabolism, 2026;28(1):83-93) and discusses relevance to the TRIUMPH-4 dysesthesia and TRANSCEND-T2D-1 arrhythmia signals
- [Novo Nordisk's Oral Wegovy Pill Wins EU-Wide Approval](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/oral-wegovy-eu-approval-2026/): European Commission granted marketing authorisation (15 July 2026) for an oral semaglutide tablet (1.5/4/9/25mg) plus a 7.2mg single-dose Wegovy pen, following a 21 May 2026 CHMP positive opinion built on OASIS 4 (NEJM, n=307, 14% vs 2% weight loss at 64 weeks) and SELECT cardiovascular outcome data; first EU-wide oral GLP-1 approval, ahead of Eli Lilly's orforglipron (Foundayo, FDA-approved 1 April 2026) securing equivalent EU clearance; separate from the UK's own 11 June 2026 MHRA approval and from retatrutide's unrelated injectable, investigational TRIUMPH programme
- [PCAC 2026: Patient Safety Groups vs Compounders](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/pcac-july-2026-comment-fight/): Partnership for Safe Medicines filed public comments (July 2026, docket FDA-2025-N-6895) urging the FDA's PCAC to reject all seven peptides under review (BPC-157, TB-500, KPV, MOTS-c, DSIP, Semax, Epitalon), citing thin human safety data; the Alliance for Pharmacy Compounding countered with a proposed "third way" — regulated compounding under clinical oversight rather than a blanket ban — arguing rejection pushes demand to the unvetted grey market documented by NPR (8 July 2026); comment docket closes 22 July, one day before the 23-24 July hearing
- [MHRA vs Tesco Pharmacy: Weight-Loss Ad Enforcement 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/tesco-pharmacy-mhra-weight-loss-ads-2026/): MHRA confirmed enforcement action against Tesco Pharmacy (7 July 2026) over prescription-only weight-loss medicine advertising, with Davies Pharmacy Havant, Southdowns Pharmacy Group and The Harper Clinic also amending ads — the first named outcome under the 18 June 2026 MHRA/ASA/GPhC joint warning; the same week an NPA survey of 310 pharmacy owners (6 July 2026) found 76% expect a significant oral Wegovy demand surge and 97% fear a bigger counterfeit-pill black market
- [FDA Peptide Vote & the $30bn Telehealth Bet](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/pcac-july-2026-telehealth-market/): Fortune (20 July 2026) reports telehealth platforms including Hims & Hers, Ro and Solace are positioning for the 23-24 July PCAC vote on BPC-157, TB-500, KPV, MOTS-c, DSIP, Semax and Epitalon; Needham sizes the addressable peptide market at roughly $30bn and Canaccord Genuity raised Hims & Hers' price target to $40 (1 July 2026) citing "growing enthusiasm" around its peptide opportunity; explains why a PCAC recommendation is advisory only, distinct from full FDA drug approval, and has no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [JAMA Secret-Shopper Study: Compounded Semaglutide and Tirzepatide Still Widely Sold](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/compounded-glp-1-secret-shopper-2026/): JAMA Health Forum (17 July 2026, DiStefano et al., University of Colorado Anschutz, DOI 10.1001/jamahealthforum.2026.2207) found 75 of 103 Oklahoma/West Virginia clinics and medical spas called Aug-Oct 2025 still offered compounded semaglutide (92.0%) and tirzepatide (86.7%) months after the FDA's 22 May 2025 shortage-based compounding cutoff; 19.0% of checked facilities lacked an active sterile compounding license and 58.7% sold additive-containing formulations; distinct from the 23-24 July PCAC hearing on never-approved research peptides, and has no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Retatrutide vs Zenagamtide (Amycretin): Triple-Agonist vs GLP-1/Amylin Trial Data](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-zenagamtide-amycretin/): Novo Nordisk's zenagamtide (amycretin), a GLP-1/amylin dual agonist, reported up to 14.6% weight loss and a 1.71-point A1C reduction in a Phase 2b type 2 diabetes trial (poster 1730-P, ADA 2026 Scientific Sessions, 5-8 June 2026), building on its earlier Phase 1b/2a obesity data (Dahl et al., The Lancet, 12 July 2025, up to 24.3% weight loss at 36 weeks); compares both datasets with retatrutide's completed Phase 3 TRIUMPH-1 (28.3-30.3% weight loss) and TRANSCEND-T2D-1 (A1C -2.0pp) results, noting zenagamtide remains roughly two trial phases behind
- [Retatrutide TRIUMPH-2 & TRIUMPH-3 Report: Diabetes and Cardiovascular Phase 3 Results](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-triumph-2-3-results-2026/): Eli Lilly topline results (23 July 2026) — TRIUMPH-2 (n=1,152, T2D + obesity) reported up to 20.8% weight loss and 1.6pp A1C reduction at 80 weeks; TRIUMPH-3 (n=1,949, obesity + established cardiovascular disease) reported up to 22.6% weight loss; TRIUMPH-3's pre-specified MACE analysis was underpowered and inconclusive (MACE-5 HR 0.82, 95% CI 0.55-1.22); Lilly now targets a Q1 2027 BLA submission
- [PCAC Votes to Clear 6 of 7 Peptides, Rejects DSIP](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/pcac-july-2026-vote-outcome/): FDA's Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee voted 23-24 July 2026 to recommend BPC-157, KPV and TB-500 (8-6, one abstention) and MOTS-c (7-5, two abstentions) on day one, then Semax (8-5) and Epitalon (7-4) on day two; DSIP/emideltide was the sole rejection (6-7); overrides FDA staff's own recommendation against all seven; vote is advisory only and does not affect UK research-reagent supply
- [Retatrutide vs Aleniglipron: Injectable Triple Agonist vs Oral GLP-1 Phase 2b Data](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-aleniglipron-oral-glp1/): Structure Therapeutics' aleniglipron, an oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist (Nature Medicine, 5 June 2026), reported up to 11.3% placebo-adjusted weight loss at 36 weeks (Phase 2b ACCESS trial, n=230) and up to 16.2% in an open-label extension; compares this with retatrutide's completed Phase 3 TRIUMPH-1 result of 28.3% at 80 weeks; Phase 3 for aleniglipron planned Q3 2026
- [Peptide Research Week in Review: 20-27 July 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-research-week-in-review-27-july-2026/): weekly digest tying together the two biggest stories of the week — retatrutide's TRIUMPH-2/3 Phase 3 topline results (23 July, up to 20.8%/22.6% weight loss) and the FDA PCAC's 23-24 July vote recommending 6 of 7 peptides (BPC-157, TB-500, KPV, MOTS-c, Semax, Epitalon) for compounding; covers Lilly's Q1 2027 BLA target, the PCAC rulemaking timeline, and the second PCAC hearing expected before end-February 2027 (GHK-Cu, Melanotan II, LL-37, DiHexa, PEG-MGF); neither story changes UK research-reagent supply
- [Teens, TikTok & Gray-Market Peptides (2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/gray-market-peptides-tiktok-teens-2026/): Air Mail (27 July 2026), the Wall Street Journal (16 May 2026), RNZ (24 April 2026) and ScienceAlert (early July 2026) report a months-long trend of teenagers self-injecting unregulated gray-market retatrutide, melanotan and GHK-Cu after watching TikTok tutorials (#Peptide hashtag: 342,000+ videos); distinguishes unregulated direct-to-consumer sales from HPLC-verified research reagents and has no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Why Did Lilly Delay Retatrutide's FDA Filing to 2027?](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-fda-filing-delay-cmc-2027/): Eli Lilly confirmed (23 July 2026, CNBC/Forbes/BioPharma Dive) that retatrutide's Biologics License Application will now be filed in Q1 2027, later than previously guided, citing extra time needed for manufacturing and quality-control (CMC) data rather than any change in trial results; announced alongside TRIUMPH-2 (20.8% weight loss) and TRIUMPH-3 (22.6% weight loss) topline data, Lilly's fourth and fifth positive Phase 3 readouts; LLY shares rose ~2% on the news; has no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [PCAC Panel's Industry Ties: 8 Deciding Votes](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/pcac-panel-industry-ties-2026/): AP reporting (carried by NBC News, Healio 1 July 2026, Becker's Hospital Review) found most of 8 new temporary voting members added to the FDA's PCAC in late June 2026 had financial ties to peptide-selling clinics (named: Dr Haleem Mohammed/Gameday Men's Health, Dr Gabriel Alizaidy/Maximus Health, Sen. Bobby Harshbarger/pharmacist); that 8-member bloc voted yes as a group on the 23-24 July BPC-157/TB-500/KPV vote (8-6, one abstention), supplying the entire winning margin; Bloomberg Law reports FDA later added more academic/clinical voting members after the criticism; vote remains advisory only and has no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Bolt Pharmacy's Fake Reviews: ASA Ruling](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/asa-bolt-pharmacy-weight-loss-ads-2026/): ASA ruling (29 July 2026, ref A26-1335405) found Bolt Healthcare Ltd (Bolt Pharmacy) ran an undisclosed Facebook advertising page, "UK Weight Loss Reviews," breaching CAP Code recognition-of-marketing rules, and that four Bolt Pharmacy ads (Feb/Apr 2026) unlawfully advertised prescription-only Wegovy and Mounjaro to the public; lands three weeks after MHRA's Tesco Pharmacy action and a same-week Phlo Technologies/Morrisons POM ruling, part of an 18-company 2026 MHRA enforcement tally; advertising-conduct story only, no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Peptide Research Week in Review: 1 August 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-research-week-in-review-1-august-2026/): weekly digest (28 Jul-1 Aug 2026) covering CNN's 31 July mainstream explainer on the FDA PCAC peptide vote, continued AP/Bloomberg Law reporting on the panel's industry-tied voting bloc, and the ASA's 29 July ruling against Bolt Pharmacy; no new retatrutide trial data this week, BLA target still Q1 2027; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Novo Nordisk Sues Eli Lilly Over GLP-1 Ad Claims](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/novo-nordisk-eli-lilly-glp1-ad-lawsuit-2026/): Novo Nordisk filed a federal lawsuit (21 July 2026, D. New Jersey) alleging Eli Lilly's Zepbound/Mounjaro ads compare high tirzepatide doses to outdated, lower Wegovy/Ozempic doses while omitting the FDA-approved 7.2mg Wegovy dose (March 2026); Novo plans a preliminary-injunction motion for 17 August 2026; Lilly says its trial-based comparisons are accurate; a commercial advertising dispute between two licensed drugs, unrelated to retatrutide's investigational Phase 3 programme and with no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [FDA 503B Comment Period Closes: What's Next for Compounded GLP-1s?](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/fda-503b-comment-period-closed-2026/): the public comment window on FDA's proposal to exclude semaglutide, tirzepatide and liraglutide from the 503B Bulks List closed 30 July 2026 with no final determination yet issued; explains the procedural next step, contrasts this 503B docket with the separate 23-24 July 2026 PCAC 503A vote, and notes no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Eli Lilly Opens Retatrutide Expanded Access Beyond the First Patient](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-expanded-access-program-2026/): STAT News (3 August 2026) reports Eli Lilly confirmed it will open pre-approval expanded access to retatrutide beyond the single 79-year-old patient disclosed in June 2026, with published eligibility criteria (refractory obesity, 2+ serious complications, no trial alternative) and a new ClinicalTrials.gov registration (NCT07629401); Lilly's Q1 2027 BLA timeline is unchanged; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Retatrutide vs Tirzepatide vs Semaglutide: MC4R-Deficient Obesity Mouse Study](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-mc4r-deficient-obesity-mouse-study-2026/): peer-reviewed study (Hitaka et al., International Journal of Obesity, February 2026, PMID 41723268) dosed MC4R-knockout mice for 21 days — tirzepatide cut weight 31.6%, retatrutide 24.1%, semaglutide 19.7%, with all three improving insulin, HOMA-IR, cholesterol and liver-enzyme markers; contrasts with the only published human MC4R-mutation subgroup data, a tirzepatide-only SURMOUNT-1 analysis (Bhatnagar et al., Nature Medicine, 26 August 2025); preclinical rodent data, no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Peptide Research Week in Review: 6 August 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-research-week-in-review-6-august-2026/): weekly digest (2-6 Aug 2026) covering Eli Lilly formalising retatrutide's expanded access programme (3 Aug, NCT07629401) amid STAT-reported doctor pushback, the MC4R mouse study reaching wider coverage (5 Aug), the FDA's 503B comment period (closed 30 Jul, no ruling yet) and the approaching 17 Aug Novo Nordisk v. Eli Lilly injunction motion; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Retatrutide's FDA Biologic Classification Fight](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-fda-biologic-classification-lawsuit-2026/): Eli Lilly's lawsuit over whether retatrutide is a "drug" (NDA) or "biological product" (BLA) under the FDA's >40-amino-acid protein definition (Eli Lilly v. Becerra, No. 1:24-cv-01503, S.D. Ind., filed 3 Sep 2024); a 30 Sep 2025 ruling vacated the FDA's classification and remanded it, Lilly appealed to the Seventh Circuit 13 Feb 2026, and as of early Aug 2026 (BioSpace) the dispute remains unresolved as Lilly's Q1 2027 filing target nears; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Tirzepatide Cuts Cardiovascular Risk: BMJ Study](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/tirzepatide-cardiovascular-cohort-study-2026/): BMJ population-based cohort study (published 5 August 2026, DOI 10.1136/bmj-2026-100011, PMID 42556854) of 52,971 US claims-database patients aged 40+ with type 2 diabetes and established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease found tirzepatide initiators (n=35,353) had a one-year MACE rate of 2.9% vs 4.4% for sitagliptin initiators (n=17,618), HR 0.68 (95% CI 0.58-0.80); MI HR 0.67, ischaemic stroke HR 0.91 (no meaningful difference); NIH/German Heart Foundation funded, independent of Eli Lilly; contrasted with retatrutide's own underpowered TRIUMPH-3 MACE signal (HR 0.82); no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Retatrutide's Phase 3 Package Is Complete: Lilly Q2 2026 Earnings](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-phase-3-complete-lilly-q2-earnings-2026/): Eli Lilly's Q2 2026 results (5 August 2026) confirmed retatrutide's Phase 3 clinical data package is complete for obesity, obstructive sleep apnea and knee osteoarthritis, with the Q1 2027 BLA target unchanged; Mounjaro+Zepbound sales reached ~$14.8bn for the quarter (Mounjaro $9.9bn +91%, Zepbound US $4.9bn +44%) vs Novo Nordisk's ~$9.16bn Wegovy+Ozempic franchise, giving Lilly a 60.9% vs 38.8% US obesity/diabetes market share; Novo shares fell ~5% on results day despite a revenue beat; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [MHRA Approves Foundayo (Orforglipron): UK First in Europe](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/orforglipron-foundayo-mhra-uk-2026/): MHRA authorised Eli Lilly's oral small-molecule GLP-1 Foundayo (orforglipron) on 10 August 2026 for weight management and type 2 diabetes, the first European approval; ATTAIN-1 (NEJM) reported 11.2% weight loss at 72 weeks (36mg vs placebo 2.1%) and ACHIEVE-3 (Lancet, n=1,698) reported orforglipron superior to oral semaglutide on A1C and weight at 52 weeks; UK launch expected later August 2026 via private prescription, NICE guidance due 18 November 2026; contrasts orforglipron's non-peptide, single-receptor, oral mechanism with retatrutide's unlicensed, injectable, triple-receptor investigational profile; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [MHRA Yellow Card Data: 216 Suspected Deaths Reported for GLP-1 Medicines](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/mhra-yellow-card-glp1-deaths-report-2026/): MHRA Yellow Card scheme data reported 6 August 2026 logged 216 cumulative suspected-link death reports across tirzepatide/Mounjaro (120 deaths of 106,309 total reports), semaglutide/Wegovy (59 of 48,148) and liraglutide/Saxenda (37 of 4,528); explains the spontaneous-reporting caveat (suspicion, not proven causation), the Yellow Card Biobank genetic-pancreatitis investigation (launched following a 29 Jan 2026 safety update), and UK GLP-1 usage scale (~1.5-2m+ users) as context; covers licensed pharmaceuticals only, no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Retatrutide Expanded Access: Why Clinicians Are Divided](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-expanded-access-clinician-divide-2026/): Medscape reporting (5 August 2026) found clinicians split on Eli Lilly's retatrutide expanded access programme launched 3 August 2026 &mdash; Sara Ghoneim MD called it "a long-standing and legitimate FDA pathway" if kept narrow, while Courtney Younglove MD warned patients would "flood our offices with requests" the programme cannot fulfil; Tech Times (4 Aug) put the realistic eligible US population at hundreds to low thousands; also covers a separate, longer-running Medscape report (26 June 2026) on unapproved/compounded retatrutide sold via "research use only" mislabelling; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Stanford Medicine: The Peptide Craze Is Outpacing the Science](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/stanford-medicine-peptide-craze-science-gap-2026/): Stanford Medicine feature (10 August 2026) quotes pathology researchers Katrin Svensson PhD ("the craze is getting far ahead of the science in many ways") and Jonathan Long PhD ("there could be all sorts of contaminants in that solution that you're injecting into yourself") on lab-discovered peptides like Svensson's own BRP (Nature, March 2025, mouse/pig data only, no human trials yet) turning up for consumer self-injection; cross-references Medical Daily reporting on "research use only" label misuse, FDA warning letters for sterility violations, and BPC-157 adverse-event reports in July 2026 PCAC briefing materials; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Why Is Eli Lilly Suing Six "Research Use Only" Retatrutide Sellers?](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/eli-lilly-retatrutide-black-market-lawsuits-2026/): Eli Lilly filed six federal lawsuits (12 August 2026, CA/TX courts) against Aesthetic Envy, Astra Peptides, Legendary Peptides, Striker Pharmacy, Texas Peptides and Lone Star Peptide over black-market retatrutide sales, several mislabelled "research use only"; Lilly said lab testing of seized product found incorrect dosages (zero to overdose) and wrong active ingredients including insulin, and that it has reported 200+ entities to the FDA, DOJ, state AGs and licensing boards; distinguishes this consumer-facing mislabelling pattern from genuine research-reagent supply; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Peptide Research Week in Review: 7-13 August 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-research-week-in-review-14-august-2026/): weekly digest tying together the MHRA's 216-death Yellow Card report (6 Aug), Medscape's clinician-split coverage of retatrutide's expanded access programme (5 Aug), Stanford Medicine's "craze is getting far ahead of the science" feature (10 Aug), and Eli Lilly's six lawsuits against black-market retatrutide sellers (12 Aug); frames all four as independent symptoms of demand outrunning evidence and enforcement; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Retatrutide MASH Mouse & Hamster Study: Liver Fat vs Fibrosis](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-mash-mouse-hamster-study-2026/): peer-reviewed study (Briand et al., Obesity, 2026;34(Suppl 1):43-53, DOI 10.1002/oby.70155, PMID 41741376) tested retatrutide in diet-induced obese MASH mice (5-week dosing) and hamsters — body weight fell 31% vs vehicle (p&lt;0.0001) and hepatic triglycerides fell ~50% in both species, but histopathological fibrosis and inflammation scores did not significantly improve; contrasts with human Phase 2a MASLD imaging data (Sanyal et al., Nature Medicine, 2024, 86% liver-fat reduction); preclinical rodent data, no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Why Did Novo Nordisk Seek an Injunction Against Lilly's GLP-1 Ads?](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/novo-nordisk-lilly-injunction-hearing-2026/): Novo Nordisk filed a preliminary-injunction motion (14 August 2026, D. New Jersey, per Law360) in its 21 July 2026 Lanham Act suit against Eli Lilly, asking the court to immediately halt Zepbound/Mounjaro ads comparing 50lb average loss to an outdated 33lb (2.4mg) Wegovy dose while omitting the FDA-approved 7.2mg dose (March 2026); court considered the motion 17 August 2026, no ruling reported yet; Lilly says its head-to-head trial data is accurate; commercial ad dispute between two licensed drugs, no bearing on retatrutide or UK research-reagent supply
- [Retatrutide vs CagriSema: Triple-Agonist vs GLP-1/Amylin Trial Data](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-cagrisema/): Novo Nordisk's CagriSema (cagrilintide 2.4mg + semaglutide 2.4mg) missed its non-inferiority endpoint against Eli Lilly's tirzepatide 15mg (Zepbound) in the REDEFINE-4 head-to-head Phase 3 trial (n=809, topline 23 Feb 2026, 23.0% vs 25.5% weight loss at 84 weeks); compares REDEFINE-1 (NEJM, Garvey et al., n=3,417, 22.7% weight loss) and REDEFINE-2 (NEJM, Davies/Bajaj et al., n=1,206, 15.7% weight loss + A1C -2.0pp) with retatrutide's Phase 3 TRIUMPH-1 (28.3-30.3%) and TRIUMPH-2 (up to 20.8%) results; CagriSema's FDA NDA was filed 18 December 2025 with a decision anticipated Q4 2026, versus retatrutide's Q1 2027 BLA target
- [New PNAS Study: AgRP Neurons and GLP-1 Weight Loss](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/glp-1-agrp-neuron-mechanism-2026/): PNAS study (d'Avila, Cavalcanti-de-Albuquerque, Collado-Perez et al., Yale School of Medicine, published 4 August 2026, DOI 10.1073/pnas.2614476123) found sustained semaglutide treatment recruits and activates hypothalamic AgRP hunger neurons in female mice rather than suppressing them, and that silencing/ablating these neurons blunted the drug's weight-lowering effect despite continued food-intake suppression, implicating glucocorticoid signalling as a candidate link (per Yale News, 10 August 2026); mouse-only, female-only data on a licensed drug (semaglutide), not retatrutide; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [BPC-157 Gets Its First Controlled Human Trial](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/bpc-157-first-human-trial-hamstring-2026/): Hudson Biotech's NCT07437547, a randomised double-blind placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial of BPC-157 in 120 adults with MRI-confirmed acute grade II hamstring strain (14-day dosing, co-primary endpoints of return-to-sport time and Day-14 MRI injury volume), has been recruiting since February 2026 with primary completion estimated February 2027; the first properly controlled human RCT of BPC-157 ever to reach active recruitment, following a 2015 registration (NCT02637284) that never posted results, and arriving after the July 2026 FDA PCAC vote where career scientists said existing BPC-157 evidence was too thin to establish safety or effectiveness; no results yet, no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Peptide Research Week in Review: 14-20 August 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-research-week-in-review-21-august-2026/): weekly digest tying together Novo Nordisk's 14 Aug preliminary-injunction motion against Eli Lilly's Zepbound/Mounjaro ads (considered 17 Aug, no ruling yet), a retatrutide MASH mouse/hamster study (Briand et al., Obesity 2026) showing 31% weight loss and ~50% liver-fat reduction without significant fibrosis improvement, a Yale PNAS study (d'Avila et al., 4 Aug 2026) finding semaglutide recruits rather than suppresses AgRP hunger neurons in female mice, and BPC-157's first controlled human trial (NCT07437547) reaching active recruitment; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Seventh Circuit Sets 24 September Date for Retatrutide Appeal](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-seventh-circuit-oral-arguments-september-2026/): the Seventh Circuit scheduled oral arguments for 24 Sep 2026 (BioSpace, 19 Aug 2026) in Eli Lilly's appeal over whether retatrutide is legally a drug (NDA) or biological product (BLA); lands seven weeks after Lilly confirmed (Q2 2026 earnings, 5 Aug 2026) its TRIUMPH Phase 3 package is complete and reaffirmed a Q1 2027 BLA/NDA filing target; a circuit ruling typically takes weeks-to-months after argument and the FDA's own remand determination remains separately pending; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [TRANSCEND-CKD: Retatrutide's Kidney Trial Explained](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-transcend-ckd-kidney-trial-2026/): rationale, design and baseline-characteristics paper (Nephrology Dialysis Transplantation, 2026;41(6):1058-1068, DOI 10.1093/ndt/gfaf230) for TRANSCEND-CKD (NCT05936151), a 146-patient Phase 2b mechanistic trial testing retatrutide's effect on iohexol-measured GFR at 24 weeks in adults with obesity and CKD stage G3 (eGFR 25-75), with or without type 2 diabetes; baseline mean mGFR 49.3 mL/min/1.73m2, mean age 65.1, 37.7% with T2D; only design/baseline published so far, topline efficacy results still pending, separate from the larger TRIUMPH-Outcomes cardiovascular/kidney trial expected 2028+; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [HPRA Warns Public After Black-Market Retatrutide Sales Surge in Ireland](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/hpra-retatrutide-warning-ireland-2026/): RTÉ reported (23 Aug 2026) that Prof Donal O'Shea (HSE National Clinical Lead for Obesity) described a patient hospitalised with vomiting and kidney injury after getting black-market retatrutide twice weekly from a personal trainer; HPRA detention data show GLP-1-claiming items seized rose from 1,582 (2024) to 48,752 (2025), a ~30-fold rise, with lab testing finding some detained transdermal patches didn't contain the semaglutide claimed on the label; retatrutide remains unapproved by the HPRA, MHRA, EMA or FDA; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [What a New Meta-Analysis Found About Retatrutide, Blood Pressure and Lipids](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-blood-pressure-lipid-meta-analysis-2026/): independent meta-analysis (Simental-Mendia, Barragan-Zuniga, Reyes-Avitia; High Blood Pressure & Cardiovascular Prevention, 2026, DOI 10.1007/s40292-026-00812-6) pooling randomised controlled trials of retatrutide found significant reductions in systolic BP (WMD -6.79 mmHg), diastolic BP (WMD -2.46 mmHg), total cholesterol (WMD -21.88 mg/dL), LDL-C (WMD -13.10 mg/dL) and triglycerides (WMD -40.90 mg/dL, all p<0.0001), with no significant change in HDL-C (p=0.98); contrasted with single-trial TRIUMPH-1 ADA 2026 cardiometabolic data; independent academic analysis, not Lilly-authored; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Peptide Research Week in Review: 21-25 August 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-research-week-in-review-26-august-2026/): weekly digest tying together the Seventh Circuit's 24 Sep 2026 oral-argument date in Lilly's retatrutide drug-vs-biologic appeal (reported 19 Aug), the TRANSCEND-CKD kidney trial's published design/baseline data (Nephrol Dial Transplant, 24-week efficacy still pending), Ireland's HPRA warning after a black-market retatrutide hospitalisation (RTÉ, 23 Aug), and the independent BP/lipid meta-analysis (25 Aug); no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Gray-Market Retatrutide: Real-World Outcomes vs Clinical Trial Data](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-gray-market-real-world-outcomes-2026/): EHR-based cohort study reported by Medscape (26 Aug 2026) found compounded/direct-to-consumer retatrutide users lost 7.2% body weight at 6-12 months vs 15.5% in a matched trial-arm cohort (n=89 trial, n=243 DTC, matched against 890 semaglutide and 890 tirzepatide initiators); pooled retatrutide cohort showed higher new-onset cardiovascular (RR 1.56) and neuropsychiatric (RR 1.95) symptom risk than comparators; nontrial use grew ~1.8x per quarter since Oct 2023; ties to Lilly's Aug 2026 lawsuits finding seized vials contained wrong doses/actives; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Injectable Peptide Evidence Review 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/injectable-peptide-evidence-review-2026/): structured narrative review (Villegas Meza, Nocek, Mitchell et al., Steadman Philippon Research Institute; JBJS Reviews 2026;14(5), DOI 10.2106/JBJS.RVW.26.00027, PMID 42160466) screened three databases for human/translational studies (Jan 2020-Aug 2025) and found GLP-1 receptor agonists are the only injectable peptide class with reproducible RCT evidence for a musculoskeletal indication (knee OA symptoms via weight loss), while BPC-157, thymosin-derived peptides (e.g. TB-500), CJC-1295, ipamorelin and tesamorelin remain investigational with limited human data, uncertain safety, product-quality concerns and WADA S2 antidoping restrictions; peer-reviewed literature audit, not a new dataset; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [MOTS-c Mitochondrial Bioenergetics Study (2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/mots-c-mitochondrial-bioenergetics-study-2026/): University of Copenhagen mechanistic study (Gudiksen, Hansen, van der Stede, Pilegaard et al.; Free Radical Biology and Medicine 2026;246:682-696, DOI 10.1016/j.freeradbiomed.2026.01.002, PMID 41520850) found MOTS-c (5.0 mg/kg IP, 5d/wk x 4wk) improved intrinsic skeletal-muscle mitochondrial bioenergetic efficiency and lowered ROS emission/ROS-related protein damage in mice, dependent on both PGC-1a and AMPK (blunted in PGC-1a and AMPK knockout mice), without increasing mitochondrial protein content; a separate observational human microdialysis arm (n=8) found interstitial MOTS-c rose with one-legged knee-extensor exercise but no significant arteriovenous difference, with no exogenous MOTS-c administered to any human participant; distinct from Hudson Biotech's Phase 2a clinical trial
- [NAD+ Systematic Review: What 113 Studies Show (2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/nad-plus-anti-aging-systematic-review-2026/): PRISMA-guided systematic review (Gallagher, Emmanuel; Ageing Research Reviews, 2026;116:103057, DOI 10.1016/j.arr.2026.103057, PMID 41655607) screened studies from Jan 2010-Oct 2025 and identified 113 eligible NAD+ intervention studies (33 human, 28 randomised; 80 rodent); oral NAD+ precursors (NR, NMN) consistently raised NAD+-related biomarkers in humans but clinical-outcome evidence remained mixed and endpoint-specific, and the authors found no eligible outcome trials evaluating intravenous or intramuscular NAD+ itself for anti-ageing or wellness indications; literature synthesis, not a new trial; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [GLP-1 Drugs and Opioid Use Disorder: What a New Safety Study Found (2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/glp-1-opioid-use-disorder-safety-study-2026/): target trial emulation (Hussain, Al Faysal, Kotecha et al.; Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism, 2026;28(8):6861-6873, DOI 10.1111/dom.70867; Medscape coverage 3 Aug 2026) used MarketScan commercial claims (2016-2023) to match 2,669 GLP-1 receptor agonist initiators against 2,669 non-initiators with opioid use disorder (n=5,338 total); found no increased gastrointestinal, renal, respiratory or psychiatric risk across ten prespecified outcomes, and lower risk for pancreatitis, insomnia and anxiety vs non-use; a safety study of licensed pharmaceutical GLP-1 drugs, not an efficacy trial and not about retatrutide specifically; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Peptide Research Week in Review: 26 Aug-1 Sep 2026](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-research-week-in-review-1-september-2026/): weekly digest tying together five items published this week: a Medscape-reported gray-market retatrutide cohort study (26 Aug, 7.2% vs 15.5% weight loss vs trial arm), a JBJS Reviews injectable-peptide sports-medicine evidence audit (28 Aug, only GLP-1s have RCT evidence), a University of Copenhagen MOTS-c mitochondrial mechanism study (29 Aug, mice only), a 113-study NAD+ systematic review (30 Aug, no IV/IM NAD+ trials found), and a GLP-1/opioid-use-disorder safety study (31 Aug, no increased risk, n=5,338); no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [Tirzepatide Wins FDA Cardiovascular Indication (2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/tirzepatide-fda-cardiovascular-approval-2026/): the FDA approved a new indication for Mounjaro (tirzepatide) to reduce cardiovascular death, MI or stroke risk in high-risk type 2 diabetes adults (28 Aug 2026), based on SURPASS-CVOT (NCT04255433; NEJM 2025;393:2409-2420, DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2505928) - a randomised trial of 13,165 adults vs dulaglutide; primary MACE endpoint HR 0.92 (95.3% CI 0.83-1.01), meeting noninferiority (P=0.003) but not superiority (P=0.09); first dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist with a CV indication; distinct from the earlier BMJ observational cohort study (tirzepatide vs sitagliptin); no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [MHRA's Illegal Retatrutide Manufacturing Raids (2026)](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/mhra-illegal-retatrutide-manufacturing-raids-2026/): between Oct 2025 and 28 May 2026 the MHRA's Criminal Enforcement Unit dismantled three illegal UK operations making counterfeit retatrutide/tirzepatide injection pens - a Northampton warehouse (Oct 2025, 2,000+ pens, gov.uk), linked Lincolnshire/Nottinghamshire premises (25 Feb 2026, ~2,000 doses, gov.uk), and a Northampton country estate (28 May 2026, ~12,000 doses, 2 arrests under the Human Medicines Regulations 2012, gov.uk) - the MHRA's largest ever such seizure; sits alongside its 2025 annual report of ~£45m in illegal medicines seized including 5,000+ GLP-1 products; concerns finished counterfeit consumer pens, not research reagents; no bearing on UK research-reagent supply
- [All guides](https://veloxpeps.com/guides/): glossary, testing methodology, compound comparisons (e.g. retatrutide vs tirzepatide vs semaglutide)
